bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks and bags larger than 9 × 11 inches must be checked at the $5 credit-card-only coat and bag check. Security may inspect bags.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Metro has no dedicated patron parking. Metered spaces on Clark Street and nearby pay lots are options.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Metro’s directions and policy page does not designate a rideshare pickup or drop-off location.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Alcohol and a range of nonalcoholic drinks are available. To drink alcohol, guests aged 21 or older must present current physical ID and wear a wristband.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The stage-viewing room is up two flights of stairs and the balcony is up a total of 41 stairs; Metro says it is not wheelchair accessible. Request limited balcony seating at least two weeks ahead or hearing assistance at least three weeks ahead.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Metro usually does not allow re-entry; its door staff may allow it for smokers aged 21 or older at selected shows. Ask staff about that night’s rule.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Pick up will-call admission by checking in at the guest list with a physical ID matching the ticket buyer’s name; no physical ticket is issued.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Metro is at 3730 North Clark Street, with its box office next door at 3728 North Clark. Guests should carry valid physical ID as proof of age at entry.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
